"""Uses of removed names are reported with their replacement; the rest of the file is rewritten."""

import threetears.evals.kernel
from threetears.evals import ops
from threetears.evals import host as evals_host
from threetears.evals.host import OpsHost
from threetears.evals.ops import await_job
from threetears.evals.run import regrade
from threetears.evals.testing import start_run


def wait(host: OpsHost, ids: list[str]) -> object:
    start_run(host)
    regrade(host)
    ops.await_job(host, ids)
    with_patch = "threetears.evals.ops.await_job"
    return threetears.evals.kernel.extract_json(with_patch), evals_host.runs_list(host)


def describe() -> str:
    """Waits with ``threetears.evals.ops.await_job``."""
    return "see threetears.evals.kernel.extract_json"
